The '''New Republic Special Forces''', also known as '''New Republic SpecForces''', was a [[Special forces/Legends|special operations service]] division within the military of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. They served within the [[New Republic Army]] which itself was part of the [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|New Republic Defense Force]].

==History==
It was the successor of [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]] and was formed shortly after the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] took the galactic capital of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. After the establishment of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the Special Forces continued their service to the new government and remained under the command of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]] until his death. Compared to their Rebel Alliance predecessors the New Republic SpecForces were better trained and had better equipment though tended to possess less experience. They became a vital resource in the continued war against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] until the resignation of [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]]. After that period, the Special Forces were used in defensive operations and as a quick deployment force in times of conflict.<ref name="RoE:TRSH">''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]''</ref> It was reorganized as the [[Galactic Alliance Special Forces]] in [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]].
